/* Attd07Mapper.selectDailyAttdDetailHistory */
SELECT B.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , B.HIST_ID AS histId , B.ATTD_ID AS attdId , B.HIST_TYPE AS histType , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( B.CMPNY_CD , 'SYST_VAL' , B.HIST_TYPE , 'SYS032' ) AS histTypeNm , A.WORK_SEQ AS workSeq , B.BEF_CHECK_IN_DATE AS befCheckInDate , B.BEF_CHECK_IN_TIME AS befCheckInTime , B.BEF_CHECK_OUT_DATE AS befCheckOutDate , B.BEF_CHECK_OUT_TIME AS befCheckOutTime
, B.AFT_CHECK_IN_DATE AS aftCheckInDate , B.AFT_CHECK_IN_TIME AS aftCheckInTime , B.AFT_CHECK_OUT_DATE AS aftCheckOutDate , B.AFT_CHECK_OUT_TIME AS aftCheckOutTime
, B.PROCESS_REASON AS processReason , B.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( B.CMPNY_CD , 'USER_NM' , B.INSERT_NO , null ) AS insertNm , B.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate FROM TB_USER_ATTD_HIST B LEFT JOIN TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT A ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.ATTD_ID = B.ATTD_ID ) WHERE B.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND B.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND B.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND ( A.USER_CD = #{userCd} OR ( A.ATTD_ID IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND R.SITE_CD = B.SITE_CD AND R.WORK_YMD = B.WORK_YMD AND R.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND R.REQ_TYPE = 'ATTD_CREATE' AND R.REQ_STATUS = 'REJECTED' ) ) ) ORDER BY B.INSERT_DATE DESC

/* Attd07Mapper.selectMonthlyAttdReq */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.REQ_ID AS reqId , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , A.USER_CD AS userCd , A.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( A.CMPNY_CD , 'SYST_VAL' , A.REQ_TYPE , 'SYS032' ) AS reqTypeNm , A.REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( A.CMPNY_CD , 'SYST_VAL' , A.REQ_STATUS , 'SYS033' ) AS reqStatusNm , A.WORK_SEQ AS workSeq , A.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , A.START_DATE AS startDate , A.START_TIME AS startTime , A.END_DATE AS endDate , A.END_TIME AS endTime , A.REQ_REASON AS reqReason , A.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND A.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND A.REQ_STATUS = 'REQUESTED'

/* Attd07Mapper.selectDailyOvertimeList */ SELECT O.OT_ID AS otId , O.ATTD_ID AS attdId , O.REQ_ID AS reqId
, O.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , O.NODE_CD AS nodeCd
, O.OT_TYPE AS otType
, O.PLAN_START_DATE AS planStartDate , O.PLAN_START_TIME AS planStartTime , O.PLAN_END_DATE AS planEndDate , O.PLAN_END_TIME AS planEndTime
, O.ACTUAL_START_DATE AS actualStartDate , O.ACTUAL_START_TIME AS actualStartTime , O.ACTUAL_START_METHOD AS actualStartMethod , O.ACTUAL_END_DATE AS actualEndDate , O.ACTUAL_END_TIME AS actualEndTime , O.ACTUAL_END_METHOD AS actualEndMethod
, O.WORK_MINUTES AS workMinutes , O.BREAK_MINUTES AS breakMinutes
, O.OT_STATUS AS otStatus
, O.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate FROM TB_USER_OVERTIME_MGMT O WHERE O.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND O.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND O.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND O.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND O.DEL_YN = 'N' AND O.OT_STATUS <> 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY O.ACTUAL_START_DATE, O.ACTUAL_START_TIME
